actions.description: Other actions during Jenkins Build among which it shows whether a testReport exists.

building.description: Whether the current build is building or not

displayName.description: Display name of the build. Usually "#${build_number}"

duration.description:
Actual duration to build in milliseconds.
Duration is 0 when building is True

estimatedDuration.description: Estimated Duration to build in milliseconds.

fullDisplayName.description: Full display name of the build. Usually "test #${build_number}"

number.description: The build number. Often the same as the id

timestamp.description:
The timestamp of when the build starts in milliseconds.
You can type `date +%s` in your terminal to see the current timestamp in seconds and compare

url.description: The url that links to the Jenkins build

changeSets.description: Information on GitHub commits made on this build
